1.mascotDialogue: The queue, she is what makes this breadth-first, not depth-first! Whoever is discovered first, is explored first — FIFO order, doing the level-by-level spreading for you.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 12 is the guard that keeps BFS from looping forever — mark visited the moment you enqueue, not the moment you dequeue, or you will enqueue the same node again and again!

3.mascotDialogue: 1 and 2, both distance-one from the start — so they are visited before 3, who is distance-two from either! This is the level-order guarantee, working exactly as promised.

4.mascotDialogue: One missing line, and BFS's whole promise — visit each node exactly once — quietly stops holding for any graph that is not a simple tree.
